lines.zh: 我一步一顿，海床都在震。
lines.en: My steps shake the seabed one thud at a time.
My tall shadow passes over the reef.

lines.zh: 水从我肋边的鳃缝涌出。
lines.en: Water pushes out through the gills at my ribs.
I wade through the whole dark.
My tendrils probe the way ahead.
I crush a piece of coral underfoot.
Slow steps, but never off course.
I can bear the pressure of the deep.
I walk the edge of the trench.

lines.zh: 我每步都震得海床发响。
lines.en: Every step makes the seabed ring.
I stand like a tower.
The echo in my chest keeps sounding.
I do not hurry. I wait.

lines.zh: 海底的泥沾满了我的脚。
lines.en: Seabed silt coats my feet.
I lift one tendril.
The sculk's green glow clings to me.
I hear footsteps very far away.

lines.zh: 我的护甲是自己长出来的。
lines.en: My armour grew on me.
Weed tangles on my shoulders.
I have been still for a long while.
The sound inside me has shifted pitch.
I turn my head to the deep.
This sea is under my watch.
I am counting the currents.
The rock cracks at my feet.
Nobody dares come near here.
You are far too small.
I lower my head to look at you.
Your armour will not stop me.

lines.zh: 你站在我的索敌范围里。
lines.en: You stand within my sensing range.
I can pick out a living heartbeat.
You want to speak. I do not listen.
I strike villagers here all the same.
Your scent is faint.
My hand stops halfway up.
You stepped back. I know.
I am older than this whole reef.
You should never have come here.
I turn to find you.
That blow only scrapes off sea mud.
The echo slipped half a beat.
Green water seeps from the crack.
You struck me, so I return it.
I churn the sand off the floor.
I have not given one step.
Blood spreads in the deep.
My anger is slow, but it lasts.
You dare touch this darkness.
I do not come for food.
Holding it up will not help you.
What I smell is not food.
I stopped, but I did not come closer.
That trick works on beasts.
Feed that bait to another mouth.
You hold the bait too high.
Put that bait away.
My hunger is not in this.
I tilt my head at your bait.
One strike and you fly away.
The whole reef rings with it.
My body is like a reef.
You bounce off my flank.

lines.zh: 水温被我撞出一圈乱流。
lines.en: The impact churns the water in a ring.
Your strength cannot move the sea.
Your bones rattle from that.
I give not one step.
Step aside. I am walking through.
The sand settles a layer deeper.
A kindred one, from the deep.

lines.zh: 我们的声音能穿过海沟。
lines.en: Our voices cross the trench.
Let us keep this dark together.
Have you walked the road under the reef?
Our seaborn blood is the same.
We need not come close.
I heard the answer from far off.
Let the sea grow itself.
Hold the reef mouth.
Silence is the answer.
I pick it up and look.
This thing is too small.
In my palm it is like a grain of sand.
I press it back into the seabed.
This thing serves no purpose.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，捏着没感觉。
lines.en: So small I barely feel it in my grip.
I squeeze once, and it cracks.
It sank, so I fished it out.
I tuck it by my gills.
Not worth carrying.
Something moved on the seabed.
A heartbeat, there.
Every tendril points at you.

lines.zh: 四十八格之内，我都能感到。
lines.en: Within forty-eight blocks, I feel you.
The sound in the dark has changed.
Iron golems get the same treatment.
You should not have entered this trench.
My whole body turns to face you.
The echo is drawing in.
It begins now.
You cannot leave this trench.
I lift my whole arm.
Right here in this trench.
That echo in the trench is me.
Your heartbeat drums in my ears.
Do not rise to the surface.
I have come up from the deep.
The sea will remember you.
I track you along the seabed.
Hide behind the reef; I still know.
The distance underwater is shortening.

lines.zh: 我的触须在测你的位置。
lines.en: My tendrils measure where you are.
You cannot run fast in water.

lines.zh: 每一声脚步都压得很稳。
lines.en: Every step lands deliberately.
You just took a breath.
Villagers and golems are targets too.
I have sealed off the whole reef.
You cannot hide in the weeds.
I bear down, thud after thud.
The echo travels along the floor.
The vibration of your heartbeat reaches down.
I am waiting for one mistake.
The reef wall has you.
I raise both hands.
The surface ripples overhead.
Just those few blocks.
Do not turn around.
My shadow covers you overhead.
My whole arm slams into the seabed.
The blow shatters the reef rock.
You are pressed into the seabed.
Fifty points behind that blow.
I bring my whole foot down.
The water squeezes out in a ring of foam.
You are thrown a long way.
My tendril lashes across you.
One more, and it is over.
You caught that one.
The crack of bone is clear even through water.
The air you gasp out turns to bubbles.
I draw my hand back slowly.
You have not sunk yet.
The whole reef has gone quiet.
I rise out of the dark.
The water level dropped an inch.
A mass of shadow darkens the surface.
The echo arrives before my body.
A warden's bones, seaborn flesh.
I walk out of the trench.
The reef clatters under my feet.
The green light on me spreads.
Eight hundred and twenty-five. That lasts a while.
The surface begins to tremble.

lines.zh: 我是被召来的，不是自己来的。
lines.en: I was summoned, not born here.
The sea is pushing this way.
Did you hear that long call.
The whole temple is echoing.
I lift my head out of the water.
I set the rules here.
The seaborn divinity descends.
Retreating to shore will not help.
I step into these shallows.
Firelight through the water makes me narrow my eyes.
I crash down onto the seabed from above.
Out of the water, my whole body grows heavy.
The blast muffles into one dull sound.
A hidden shot? It will not pierce my armour.
This force is trying to press me down.
This sea has been emptied.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，我全身一震。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the surface and my whole body jolts.

lines.zh: 我的声音在虚空里断掉。
lines.en: My voice cuts off in the void.
